# Canopy golden bit-for-bit reference data — solid-harmonic far field, P = 6.
#
# Consumed by tests/tstGolden.hpp (CTest target Canopy_Test_Golden_MPI_<DEV>).
# These are bit patterns, not values: they are only meaningful for the exact
# configuration frozen in tstGolden.hpp — P = 6, NComps = 1, Scalar = double,
# mac_theta = 0.5, ncrit = 16, max_depth = 6, 400 particles per rank,
# replication_depth = 2, imbalance_tolerance = 0.05, all six box tolerances
# and ncrit_tol = 0.1, softening = 0.0 — solved on the SERIAL backend.
#
# Keyed by (nprocs, rank). The particle seed is 1234 + rank * 31 + P, so the
# particle set and every artifact derived from it is a function of both the
# rank count and the rank; ranks 1-6 is 21 sets. Cross-rank-count
# reproducibility is NOT claimed and nothing here assumes it.
#
# Provenance
# ----------
# Generated at commit 6f7907515394e7c3987d193448703662171fa077
#   (tuolumne, Cray clang 20.0.0, spack env tuolumne_trilinos,
#    RelWithDebInfo, Kokkos SERIAL backend, flux job f3XHNLmod1Wo).
# Regenerate with scripts/tuolumne/run_golden_regenerate.flux and record the
# new commit and the reason in tasks/abstract-solver-backend-progress-log.md.
# Nothing in the default test path writes this file.
#
# Format
# ------
# '#' begins a comment, to end of line. Whitespace-separated tokens; the line
# breaks below are cosmetic. One record per (nprocs, rank):
#
#   set      <nprocs> <rank>
#   locals   <ext0> <ext1> <ext2> <hash>   DownwardSweep::locals()
#   optab    <ext0> <ext1> <ext2> <hash>   M2L operator table; the hash covers
#                                          the first <nops> columns only, the
#                                          rest of extent 2 being an
#                                          uninitialized pad
#   nops     <n>                           n_unique_ops, full value
#   keys     <hash>                        realized M2L key list, sorted by
#                                          (dd, ii, jj, kk)
#   fallback <n>                           total_fallback_pair_count(); 0 for
#                                          this configuration, and asserted to
#                                          be 0 rather than pinned (see R4)
#   atable   <extent>                      A_{n,m} table, (2P+1)^2 entries
#   a        <bits> x4 ...                 full bit patterns, four per line
#   end
#
# Every <hash> is the in-repo FNV-1a-64 of tstGolden.hpp fed big-endian, and
# every <bits> is the IEEE-754 bit pattern of a double as a uint64_t. Neither
# is a value comparison: EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ has a tolerance and NaN != NaN, so
# neither can serve as a bitwise gate.
